meta.titulo: Fundev | Games and apps that engage
meta.descricao: Advergames, serious games and custom apps for businesses, schools and institutions. Explore Fundev's original games too.

hero.sub: Advergames, serious games and custom software for businesses, schools and institutions. We also make original games.

sobre.sub: Fundev started in 2024 with a simple idea: games can entertain and, at the same time, tell stories that matter. That is why, alongside our original titles, we keep projects focused on environmental preservation and accessibility.
sobre.card1Texto: We build our own worlds, mechanics and stories, from the idea on paper to the first playable build.
sobre.card2Texto: Pantany, our social project, uses games to talk about preserving the Pantanal, one of the richest and most threatened biomes in Brazil.
sobre.card3Texto: A Aventura do Folclore is being built for autistic children in Mato Grosso, designed from the start to include.
sobre.card4Texto: We are taking our first steps beyond games, building software to order: digital solutions designed from scratch for each project.

portfolio.sub: Original projects and solutions created for different goals.
portfolio.pantanyProblema: Wildfires in the Pantanal affect wildlife.
portfolio.pantanyFeito: Educational game about preserving the Pantanal.
portfolio.pantanyResultado: The game was presented at Pantanal Shopping to raise awareness among children and teenagers about deforestation.
portfolio.folcloreProblema: There are few games focused on the development of autistic children.
portfolio.folcloreFeito: For a client in Mato Grosso, we are developing a Brazilian folklore game that supports motor skills and memory, encourages creativity, and helps autistic children understand emotions.
portfolio.folcloreResultado: The game is being tested at specialized clinics.
portfolio.kindlingProblema: A need for a simple, easy-to-use video conferencing app with video streaming, simplified screen organization and customization options.
portfolio.kindlingFeito: Video calling app for online classes and meetings.
portfolio.kindlingResultado: The app is currently being tested with businesses and schools.
